content: Kadaudok kan en Paliepeng Moromorada
Reopoham ketila Sekem, wasa me tohn paliepeng koaros wie pokopokon ie pwe re en kasapwiladahng ih nanmwarki.
Ni ahnsou me Seropoham nein Nepat, me patohla Isip pwehn tangasang Nanmwarki Solomon, ahpw rongada ire wet, ih eri pwurodo.
Kadaudok en paliepeng eri ileklahng, re ahpw pokonpene rehn Reopoham oh patohwanohng,
“Semomwio ketikihong kiht wisik toutou ehu. Ma komwi pahn kamarahda wisik toutou pwukat pwe se en nsenamwahu nan at momour, se pahn wiahla sapwellimomwi aramas loalopwoat.”
Reopoham eri sapeng irail, mahsanih, “Kumwal mweidohng ie I en medemedewe mahs erein rahn siluh. Kumwail eri pwurodo rehi.” Aramas ako eri kohkohla.
Reopoham eri rapahki kaweid rehn ohl mah kan me kin wia en seme Solomon sounkaweid. E ahpw keinemwe rehrail, mahsanih, “Ia amwail kaweid ong ire wet me I en patohwanohng irail?”
Re ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Ma komw pahn kadek ong aramas pwukat oh song en kihong irail pasapeng pwung, re pahn loalopwoatohng komwi kohkohlahte.”
Ahpw e sohte men pohnese kaweid en ohl mah kan, e ahpw ketila rehn me pwulopwul kan me irail ehu dih oh me uhd wialahr sapwellime sounkaweid.
E ahpw keinemwe rehrail, “Dahme I pahn ndahng aramas pwukat me pekipeki I en kamarahda arail wisik toutou kan?”
Re ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “Iet me komw pahn mahsanihong irail: ‘Senditikiet mosul sang lukopen semeio.’
Mahsanihong irail met, ‘Ei pahpao ketikihong kumwail wisik toutou; a ngehi I pahn kalaudehsang. E ketin wokihkin kumwail sahl; a ngehi I pahn wokihkin kumwail kilin kou!’”
Mwurin rahn siluh Seropoham oh aramas koaros ahpw pwurodo rehn Reopoham, nin duwen me e mahsanihong irail.
Nanmwarkio eri soikala en me mah kan kaweid, e ahpw mahsen kehlail ong aramas akan,
nin duwen me pwulopwul ko kaweidki. E mahsanih, “Semeio ketikihong kumwail wisik toutou; a ngehi I pahn kalaudehsang. E ketin wokihkin kumwail sahl; a ngehi I pahn wokihkin kumwail kilin kou!”
Met iei kupwur en KAUN-O Koht, pwe sapwellime mahsen en pweida, me e mahsanihong Seropoham nein Nepat sang rehn soukohp Ahisa mehn Sailo. Ih me nanmwarkio sohte men pohnesehki aramas akan.

Ahnsou me aramas akan tehkadahr me nanmwarkio sohte men karonge irail, re ahpw werida, patohwan, “Depit oh eh peneinei en riahla! Dahme irail wiahiong kitail? Ohl en Israel kan, kitail kohkohla! Reopoham en pein apwalih pein ih!” Eri, mehn Israel ahpw moromorada,
Reopoham eri wiahla nanmwarkien aramas akante me kokousoan nan Suda.

Nanmwarki Reopoham eri kadarala Adonairam, me kin pwukoahki apwahpwalih doadoahk idihd kan, en patohla rehn mehn Israel kan, ahpw re katehki takai lao ih mehla. Ni ahnsowo, Reopoham ahpw ketidahng pohn tehnwere werennasapw oh tangalahng Serusalem.
Sang ahnsowo kohdo aramas akan en paliepeng en wehin Israel kin wie moromor ong mwehin kadaudok en Depit lel rahnwet.
